module: Flowgraph node "Remove Other Vehicles" (category once_instant). Deletes all vehicles except those whose id is given on the idToIgnore_1..N pins (the number N is set in the properties). Options: onlyDrivableVehs (only uses getAllVehiclesByType) and onlyFlowgraphVehs (limits to vehicles created by the flowgraph vehicle module). Calls editor.onRemoveSceneTreeObjects if the editor is present, then obj:delete().
notes: The three settings (count, onlyDrivableVehs, onlyFlowgraphVehs) are saved with the graph.
When the number of pins decreases, the links to the removed pins are deleted.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the node's own settings from the saved data.

_onSerialize.desc: Adds the node's own settings to the `res` table when saving the graph.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the node's custom properties in the flowgraph editor panel (ImGui).

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

updatePins.desc: Adds or removes idToIgnore_i input pins to go from old to new; deletes the links of removed pins.

workOnce.desc: Executed only once (once_* category) when the node is triggered: reads the input pins and applies the effect.
